purpose: Teach: 洋子/四郎/敦/小僧/無題/赤色/紗子/和子

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお母様、洋子さんって名前だったよな
lines.en: Riku — your mom's name was Youko, right?
lines.style: Light, testing curiosity. Gentle tilt upward on the name. Probing to see where this is going, but not unkindly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会の宿題で四郎丸太郎の歴史調べてたな、桜
lines.en: You were researching that history project on Shiro Tartaro for social studies, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet observation. Factual but with a slight edge — turning her own game back on her. Measured delivery, a hint of amusement underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの敦と仲良いな
lines.en: Riku — you're pretty close with Atsu from the next class, huh?
lines.style: Direct but playful. Leaning into the observation. A half-smile in the voice. Watching for his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、漫画で「小僧、まだまだだな」って台詞気に入ってたな、桜
lines.en: You really liked that manga line, didn't you? 'You've still got a long way to go, kid.'
lines.style: Slight smirk in the delivery. Reciting it back to him with gentle mockery. He knows she caught him noticing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、美術の作品に無題って書いてたな
lines.en: Riku — you titled your art project 'Untitled,' didn't you?
lines.style: Curious, probing. A lift on the title itself — like she's caught him being deliberately vague. Light and unaccusing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、赤色の運動靴履いてたな、桜
lines.en: You were wearing those red sneakers, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Calm recall. Not accusatory. The kind of quiet observation that says 'I notice things about you too.'

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの紗子と話してたな
lines.en: Riku — I saw you talking with Sako from the next class.
lines.style: Direct statement. Curious but guarded. Testing his response. A slight pause before the name, like she's choosing her words.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科で和子先生に教わったろ、桜
lines.en: You were in Ms. Kazuko's home economics class, weren't you?
lines.style: Close, almost intimate. Quiet confidence. She's gathered the details. Warm but with an undertone of 'I know more than you think.'
